d:
Jharkhand ke mukhyamantri hemant soren aur vidhayak kalpana soren jamshedpur pahunche. yahan unhonne jharkhand ke purv mukhyamantri aur bhajpa neta arjun munda ki divangat mata ji ko shraddhanjli arpit ki aur shok sanvedna vyakt ki. is dauran rajnitik aur vyaktigat sanbandhon ka bhi jikr kiya gaya. dekhie puri khabra.
